scripts.mongo:up: docker compose up -d && npm run mongo:wait
scripts.mongo:low: docker update --cpus=0.10 --memory=384m --memory-swap=384m msoft-pda-mongo && docker stats msoft-pda-mongo --no-stream
scripts.mongo:high: docker update --cpus=2.0 --memory=1536m --memory-swap=1536m msoft-pda-mongo && docker stats msoft-pda-mongo --no-stream
scripts.mongo:wait: sh -c 'i=0; until [ "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Health.Status}}' msoft-pda-mongo 2>/dev/null)" = "healthy" ]; do i=$((i+1)); if [ "$i" -gt 60 ]; then echo Mongo no healthy; exit 1; fi; echo Esperando Mongo healthy...; sleep 2; done; echo Mongo healthy'
scripts.api:ready: sh -c 'i=0; until curl -sf -m 3 http://127.0.0.1:3001/api/empleados >/dev/null; do i=$((i+1)); if [ "$i" -gt 40 ]; then echo API no lista; exit 1; fi; echo Esperando API...; sleep 1; done; echo API lista'
scripts.stress: npm run api:ready && artillery run stress-test.yml
